title: Edit LanguageTool desktop preferences: UK spelling, no paraphrasing, picky off, tidy enabled apps
body: User approved. Quit app, back up group plist beside itself, write via defaults, relaunch, verify. Not adding to chezmoi.

cmd: shale intent "Edit LanguageTool desktop preferences: UK spelling, no paraphrasing, picky off, tidy enabled apps" --body "User approved. Quit app, back up group plist beside itself, write via defaults, relaunch, verify. Not adding to chezmoi."

set -e
P="$HOME/Library/Group Containers/N6PF5J2JR8.org.languagetool.desktop.group/Library/Preferences/N6PF5J2JR8.org.languagetool.desktop.group"
BAK="$P.plist.bak-2026-11-26"
running() { pgrep -f "Contents/MacOS/LanguageTool for Desktop$" >/dev/null; }
osascript -e 'tell application id "org.languagetool.desktop" to quit'
python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess,time,sys
for _ in range(40):
    if subprocess.run(['pgrep','-f','Contents/MacOS/LanguageTool for Desktop$'],capture_output=True).returncode: sys.exit(0)
    time.sleep(0.25)
sys.exit('app did not quit; nothing changed')
EOF
[[ -e $BAK ]] && { echo "backup already exists, stopping"; exit 1; }
cp -p "$P.plist" "$BAK"
defaults write "$P" useOxfordSpelling -bool false
defaults write "$P" globalPickyMode -bool false
defaults write "$P" hasParaphrasingTriggerEnabled -string off
defaults write "$P" enabledApps -array md.obsidian com.anthropic.claudefordesktop com.google.GeminiMacOS com.readdle.SparkDesktop.appstore com.apple.mail com.apple.MobileSMS com.microsoft.teams2 com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap net.whatsapp.WhatsApp
echo "backup: $BAK"
open -b org.languagetool.desktop
python3 -c 'import time; time.sleep(20)'
running && echo "relaunched"
for k in useOxfordSpelling globalPickyMode hasParaphrasingTriggerEnabled languageVariantEnglish enabledApps; do echo "$k = $(defaults read "$P" $k | tr -d '\n' | tr -s ' ')"; done

ps -axo pid,etime,command | grep -F 'Contents/MacOS/LanguageTool for Desktop' | grep -v grep
P="$HOME/Library/Group Containers/N6PF5J2JR8.org.languagetool.desktop.group/Library/Preferences/N6PF5J2JR8.org.languagetool.desktop.group.plist"
python3 -I - "$P" "$P.bak-2026-11-26" <<'EOF'
import plistlib,sys
new,old=(plistlib.load(open(f,'rb')) for f in sys.argv[1:3])
for k in sorted(set(new)|set(old)):
    if new.get(k)!=old.get(k): print(k,':',old.get(k),'->',new.get(k))
EOF
